protocol.scope: visit-order component only; NOT full A2 or Ota D/W/T validation

cost_projections.NN_time: same deterministic NN rule with observed travel-time matrix; NOT original road-distance NN
cost_projections.NN_geodesic: same NN rule with coordinate geodesic distance; diagnostic only, not research road D

pilot.purpose: implementation check only; no parameter or rule tuning

evaluation.selection: SHA256(seed|station), SHA256(seed|station|date), SHA256(seed|route_id); metadata only; no outcome filtering

controls.reference: actual driver sequence; no actual order supplied to generators

metrics.primary: official Amazon sequence score, lower is more similar

inference.primary_effect: NN score minus per-route mean random score; negative is improvement over random
inference.primary_test: only NN_time contrast is primary; NN_geodesic exploratory
inference.interpretation: conditional descriptive cluster-bootstrap uncertainty; improvement over random is NOT equivalence to drivers

representativeness_acceptance.reason: no justified equivalence margin or target-depot transfer data; no road-distance matrix in Amazon schema

frozen_rules: do not feed actual order to generators
do not use lower travel time alone as behavioral validity
no km or loading-wait or human-T inferred from these files
